hints.title: Symmetry Verification
hints.text: A word is a palindrome if character comparisons from opposing ends match inward.

hints.title: Sequential Search Order
hints.text: Inspect words in their original array order and return the first matching instance.

hints.title: Default Fallback
hints.text: If no word in the array meets the palindromic criteria, return an empty string.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N * L) linear scan checking symmetry
complexity.notes: Return first word matching its own reverse, or empty string.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning backwards or storing transformed lists adds overhead when early return suffices.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Two pointers check character symmetry in place with zero allocations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should return immediately upon finding the first valid palindrome.
